title: Bear and Big Brother
statementMd:
Bear Limak wants to become the largest of bears, or at least to become larger than his brother Bob.

Right now, Limak and Bob weigh $*a*$ and $*b*$ respectively. It's guaranteed that Limak's weight is smaller than or equal to his brother's weight.

Limak eats a lot and his weight is tripled after every year, while Bob's weight is doubled after every year.

After how many full years will Limak become strictly larger (strictly heavier) than Bob?

## Input

The only line of the input contains two integers $*a*$ and $*b*$ ($1 ≤ *a* ≤ *b* ≤ 10$) — the weight of Limak and the weight of Bob respectively.

## Output

Print one integer, denoting the integer number of years after which Limak will become strictly larger than Bob.

## Note

In the first sample, Limak weighs $4$ and Bob weighs $7$ initially. After one year their weights are $4·3 = 12$ and $7·2 = 14$ respectively (one weight is tripled while the other one is doubled). Limak isn't larger than Bob yet. After the second year weights are $36$ and $28$, so the first weight is greater than the second one. Limak became larger than Bob after two years so you should print $2$.

In the second sample, Limak's and Bob's weights in next years are: $12$ and $18$, then $36$ and $36$, and finally $108$ and $72$ (after three years). The answer is $3$. Remember that Limak wants to be larger than Bob and he won't be satisfied with equal weights.

In the third sample, Limak becomes larger than Bob after the first year. Their weights will be $3$ and $2$ then.
statementZhMd:
熊 Limak 想成为最大的熊，或者至少变得比他的兄弟 Bob 更大。

现在，Limak 和 Bob 的体重分别为 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$。保证 Limak 的体重小于或等于他兄弟的体重。

Limak 很能吃，他的体重每年变为原来的三倍，而 Bob 的体重每年变为原来的两倍。

经过多少个完整年份后，Limak 的体重会严格大于 Bob？

## 输入格式

输入仅一行，包含两个整数 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$（$1 ≤ *a* ≤ *b* ≤ 10$）——分别表示 Limak 和 Bob 的体重。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，表示 Limak 的体重严格大于 Bob 所需的年份数。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，Limak 和 Bob 的初始体重分别为 $4$ 和 $7$。一年后，他们的体重分别为 $4·3 = 12$ 和 $7·2 = 14$（一个体重变为原来的三倍，另一个变为原来的两倍）。此时 Limak 的体重还没有超过 Bob。第二年后，他们的体重分别为 $36$ 和 $28$，因此第一个体重大于第二个体重。Limak 在两年后变得更重，因此应输出 $2$。

在第二个样例中，Limak 和 Bob 接下来几年的体重分别为：$12$ 和 $18$，然后是 $36$ 和 $36$，最后是 $108$ 和 $72$（三年后）。答案是 $3$。请注意，Limak 想要比 Bob 更重，体重相等并不能令他满足。

在第三个样例中，Limak 在第一年后就变得更重。那时他们的体重分别为 $3$ 和 $2$。
